credit_utilization.name: Credit Utilization Ratio
credit_utilization.description: Percentage of available credit being used. High utilization (>30%) indicates higher risk.

payment_ratio.name: Payment Ratio
payment_ratio.description: Percentage of balance paid. < minimum indicates financial stress.

minimum_due_percentage.name: Minimum Due %
minimum_due_percentage.description: Percentage of balance that is the minimum payment. Higher % means longer payoff.

average_monthly_spend.name: Average Monthly Spend
average_monthly_spend.description: Customer's average monthly spending pattern. Used for anomaly detection.

late_payment_ratio.name: Late Payment Ratio
late_payment_ratio.description: Percentage of statements where payment was late. High ratio indicates default risk.

days_past_due.name: Days Past Due
days_past_due.description: Current DPD. >30 = delinquent, >60 = seriously delinquent, >90 = default.

rolling_3m_spend.name: Rolling 3-Month Average Spend
rolling_3m_spend.formula: AVG(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY transaction_date ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
rolling_3m_spend.description: 3-month moving average of spend. Used to smooth seasonal variations.

risk_score.name: Composite Risk Score
risk_score.description: Weighted risk score (0-10). 0-3 Low, 4-6 Medium, 7-8 High, 9-10 Critical.

default_probability.name: Default Probability Indicator
default_probability.formula: CASE WHEN dpd > 90 OR risk_score >= 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
default_probability.description: Binary indicator for likely default. Used for proactive collections.

customer_segments.name: Customer Risk Segments
customer_segments.formula: CASE WHEN risk_score <= 3 THEN 'Low Risk' WHEN risk_score <= 6 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN risk_score <= 8 THEN 'High Risk' ELSE 'Critical' END
customer_segments.description: Risk-based customer segments for differentiated treatment strategies.
